given.note: S1-12: Sam texts his price list as a photo (K-06 photo.json: event evt-sam-0004, attachment att-sam-price-list, image/jpeg). The Linq side (C-207, photos in) takes the photo's bytes from Linq and writes them here as the business's file. The key is the file reference that K-02's photo reading takes (02-contracts K-02 'Photo reading', kind price list) and that K-11's photo fileId names. Size and hash are placeholders.
